description: What every player gets on joining the map and on every respawn (tools/configure_spawn_loadout.py; granted by kt_spawn_supply_service in SpawnSupplies.verse). The same consumables are removed first so stacks never pile up. Player 2026-10-10: pistol, shields, meds and slurp fish. Player 2026-10-11: spawn with unlimited gold so mods can be bought at the Weapon Mod Bench (10,000 bars, topped up on every respawn).
slurp_fish_note: No slurp item is usable here: slurp fish exists only as an entity item (granters refuse it) and the creative slurp juice (Figment_Athena_PurpleStuff) fails UEFN validation (disallowed reference, 2026-10-10).
